subject: Re: CIQA kickoff - perceptual compression labels as a product asset
body:
Lucia,

Staffing plan, confirmed with everyone individually:

- Milan Zapata 50% through the window, owns the compression/sampling pipeline (ImageMagick sampling of Q>=99 sources, tf.image.adjust_jpeg_quality for recompression).
- Leilani Nakamura 40%, rater-study tooling.
- Saoirse Eriksen 30%, data validation and release packaging.
- Gustavo Moreau is locked in at 60% on CIQA for all of May 2026 to run the second rater wave and the label QA pass. I sized May around him, so please don't let anyone shave that down.

Compute is light - a few hundred A100-hours on titan-a100, best effort is fine. The real budget line is the rater panel: I'm estimating 38k pairwise judgments at roughly $0.14 each, so ~$5.3k. No Vulcan ask.

One dependency: Corpus ingestion for the label tables, but nothing that touches the v2 migration.

Jelena
